messages.subject: Replicating example from JSS paper?
parts:
Hi

I'm just discovering the very nice package reshape, and trying to
learn it from the JSS paper. I however get an error message
replicating one of the example:

library(reshape)
smithsm <- melt(smiths)
cast(smithsm, time + subject ~ variable)
Erreur : Casting formula contains variables not found in molten data:
time

Do you see what is going wrong? It seems though time is in variable...
I am using reshape 0.8.4, full infos below.

Thanks!!

Matthieu

messages.subject: Re: Replicating example from JSS paper?
parts:
Hi Matthieu,

This is a change that happened to melt awhile back. Just be explicit
about the melting variables:

smithsm <- melt(smiths, 1:2)

Hadley
